_note: v0.9.5 (§3.6, §6.3.6, catalogs/moves.md): every move is a Gen I move at its Gen I name, its type the modern one where the game has it (Gust Flying, Karate Chop Fighting, Sand Attack Ground; Bite stays Normal, there is no Dark). An `-plus` row is that move made better — what an evolution upgrades a card into when its type has no stronger Gen I move — and a Mastery tier (§6.8.4) is the Lv1 move's + and ++. AP and power sit in §6.3.6.4's bands, enforced by a content test. `call-for-help` and `cover` are enemy actions (§5.6), never learned. `targeting`: single (default) | cleave | backstrike (§4.3.4); `cooldown` gates enemy re-use (§5.3).
